triangle_constraint_falsifier.conclusion: the all-triangles-transposition condition is not sufficient to characterize the selected S3 cover, even at Hamming radius one in cotree-voltage space

theorem: Every automorphism of GQ(4,2) lifts to the selected cover, and its monodromy has the two-cycle S3 presentation. But the 270 transposition-holonomy triangle constraints do not determine the connection: a one-cotree-edge deformation already yields a distinct connected S3 cover satisfying them all.
execution: independent spanning-tree voltage reconstruction, explicit PGSp packet action, generator lift equations, and exhaustive one-cotree-edge deformation sweep
boundary: Exact finite connection/gauge theorem plus explicit nonuniqueness witness. No global classification of all S3 connections is claimed.
